title: Govt tweaks MFI credit guarantee rules — CGSMFI 2.0
summary: Banks must now push 3x more credit to small MFIs under tightened microfinance lending norms.

blocks.content: Banks must now push 3x more credit to small MFIs under tightened microfinance lending norms.

items: Run by **NCGTC** (National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company, wholly govt-owned); guarantees bank loans to NBFC-MFIs
Small/mid-MFI lending floor: **15%** of ₹20,000 crore corpus (up from 5%/10%)
Max loan sanctionable: 20% of AUM, capped at ₹100 cr (small) / ₹200 cr (medium) / ₹1,000 cr (large)
MFI classes by AUM: Small <₹500 cr | Medium ₹500 cr–<₹2,000 cr | Large >₹2,000 cr

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → Lending floor raised to 15%; AUM slabs for classification.
